status: DRAFT - not approved by Gary, NOT wired into game code
palette: art/world/overworld/palette.hex (64 colours) + full transparency; alpha is 0 or 255 only
scale_rule: draw 1x frames scaled by an integer (2x/3x) with nearest-neighbour only; *_2x files are exact nearest copies
sheet_layout: horizontal strip; frame i rect = [i*w, 0, w, h] (rects[] lists them)
emissive_rule: emissive 'all' -> grade with grades.<g>.lit (lut_<g>_lit.png); 'none' -> grades.<g>.sprite; 'mask' -> per pixel by <name>_emissive_sheet.png. Draw order: palette swaps -> grade.
about: Generic evolution overlay (MECHANICS_PARITY evolution). Works for every creature: code silhouettes the existing sprites; nothing is redrawn per creature.

silhouette.how: code: every opaque pixel of the sprite -> fill; add a 1px 4-neighbour outline. Same for old and new sprite.

hooks.alternation_rule: start on the OLD silhouette; each entry is how long to show the current silhouette before switching (old, new, old, ...). Total 2940 ms. B cancels at any point -> evo_cancel.
sequence: old sprite -> silhouette (hard cut) + evo_motes_rise loop
evo_flash (swap to new sprite at frame 3)
evo_burst, new sprite normal colours, motes stop
hooks.photosensitivity: Max 3 full-screen flashes per second; this design has ONE full-screen flash. The alternation is a sprite-sized area. The fastest alternation step is 60 ms (~8 Hz) on a sprite-sized area; if Gary wants stricter, clamp schedule entries to >= 167 ms.
hooks.warmth_cosmic: after the swap the new sprite gets the same Warmth stage and Cosmic flag (apply swaps before grading)
hooks.reduced_motion: evo_reduced_motion instead of alternation+flash; keep motes off

motes.rule: fraction of FX pixels with |dLuma|>=28 vs graded background under them, per phase; pass >= 0.5

burst.rule: fraction of FX pixels with |dLuma|>=28 vs graded background under them, per phase; pass >= 0.5

cancel.rule: fraction of FX pixels with |dLuma|>=28 vs graded background under them, per phase; pass >= 0.5

rm.rule: fraction of FX pixels with |dLuma|>=28 vs graded background under them, per phase; pass >= 0.5

flash.rule: fraction of FX pixels with |dLuma|>=28 vs graded background under them, per phase; pass >= 0.0
flash.note: full-screen white: readable by definition; dims at night (fcf6e8 is not a lit colour). Kept, judged by eye.

silhouette_old.rule: fraction of FX pixels with |dLuma|>=28 vs graded background under them, per phase; pass >= 0.5
silhouette_old.note: code-made silhouette (fcf6e8 + 8a4ace outline), checked because it is the main visual

anchor.meaning: same bottom-centre anchor as the creature battle sprite (160 canvas; for 128 sprites the creature anchor [64,125] maps to this point)

evo_motes_rise.notes: Light motes rising around the creature during "What? X is evolving!" and through the silhouette alternation.

evo_flash.notes: Single full-screen white flash in Bayer steps (never a blend). Starts when the schedule ends; swap to the new sprite on frame 3 (fully white). ONE flash only.

evo_burst.notes: Reveal burst around the new form, plays right after evo_flash frame 4.

evo_cancel.notes: Player pressed B: motes fall back and the ring closes; old sprite returns un-silhouetted on frame 0.

evo_reduced_motion.notes: Reduced motion: no alternation, no full-screen flash. Show old sprite, play this, swap on frame 1.
